title: Libra-Leaderboard: Towards Responsible AI through a Balanced Leaderboard of Safety and Capability
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus was on general safety and capability, with safety categories including 'bias and discrimination', but without a specified religious component.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the evaluation.
